result.title: Long-Horizon RL Needs Muon
result.summary: Long-horizon agents must coordinate reasoning, tool use, and environment feedback over extended interactions. Learning from sparse outcome rewards requires weighting trajectories of different lengths and updating the policy while rollouts are still being collected. We examine a single-rollout asynchronous recipe combining Muon, token-averaged loss, truncated importance sampling, and auxiliary length and tool-error penalties. Single-rollout sampling allows asynchronous learning without waiting for multiple trajectories for the same issue. We study optimizer choices and recipe components for repository-level issue resolution across two model families. The evaluated training runs show higher training success with the full recipe than with the baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究长时程智能体的强化学习训练配方，将 Muon 优化器与 token 平均损失、截断重要性采样、长度惩罚和工具错误惩罚组合，采用单 rollout 异步采样在仓库级 issue 解决任务上考察优化器与各组件的作用。
AI.relevance_reason: 属纯文本 agent RL，与 LVR 主线无直接交集；但其 token 平均损失与长度惩罚涉及变长轨迹的信用分配与长度泛化，可能为推理长度收益/成本权衡与轨迹监督提供可核查的方法线索。
